d:
Joshua Wong, once the teenage face of Hong Kong’s pro-democracy movement, has been sentenced to another 10 years in prison for colluding with foreign forces. Wong had already spent nearly six years in prison and was due to be released in January 2027. With this latest sentence, he is now expected to remain behind bars until late 2036. Samah Qundeel explains who Joshua Wong is and how he became the face of the protest.
